item.title: British firm offers to restart mothballed Australian manganese smelter
item.description: Natrium Redox Technologies, a green technology startup based in Britain, said on Monday that it had made a firm proposal to the Tasmanian government to acquire and restart Australia's only manganese smelter, to supply global battery and electric vehicle markets.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Natrium Redox Technologies, a green technology startup based in Britain, said on Monday that it had made a firm proposal to the Tasmanian government to acquire and restart Australia's only manganese smelter, to supply global battery and electric vehicle markets. Administrators EY Parthenon said last month the Liberty Bay Smelter would [USN:L6N43I043 TEXT:"close"] after a proposed sale fell through. The smelter, formerly owned by British billionaire Sanjeev Gupta's GFG Alliance, entered voluntary administration in March after suspending operations mid-last year. "We have engaged with EY Parthenon and the Tasmanian government on this proposal for six months. We have also briefed the federal government," Natrium Redox Technologies said in a statement. "Our restart proposal seeks shared input of funds with government to the level of A$15 million ($10.75 million) for a 16-week restart period and a continuation of the existing electricity contract." EY Parthenon had no immediate comment. ($1 = 1.3953 Australian dollars)

item.title: マクロスコープ：高まる片山財務相続投論、関係者が「確定的」と語る背景
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara Yoshifumi Takemoto
[東京 ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara　Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２４日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相が９月中旬以降に踏み切る見通しの内閣改造に絡み、政府内で片山さつき財務相の続投論が高まっている。事情に精通する政府関係者はロイターの取材に、具体的な理由を挙げつつ続投が確定的だと言い切った。財務相は「責任ある積極財政」の具体化に取り組む政権の要だ。高市氏が片山氏にそのポストを託し続ける背景や今後の見通しを、複数の関係者や専門家への取材から探る。

＜日米当局の関係＞

「財務相ポストは続投で決まりだ」。自民党関係者はロイターの取材にこう述べた。政府関係者も「確定的になったと言っていい」と同様の認識を示した。

関係者が理由に挙げるのは、片山氏のある「実績」だ。片山氏は７月３１日、日米による円買いの協調介入を実行した。３日後には両政府が足並みを揃えて談話を発表。片山氏は記者団の取材に応じると「（日米当局間は）様々なことを緊密に連携し、Ｇ７（主要７カ国）を実りある方向へ持っていこうという意味では非常にうまくいっている」と、カウンターパートであるベセント米財務長官との密接な関係をアピールしてみせた。

また、高市首相が掲げる財政政策を念頭に、「（日本が）成長のボタンを押して押して押し続けることについて（米国から）非常に高い評価をいただいている」と付け加えることも忘れなかった。

＜高市首相の評価＞

米国自身が中東情勢の悪化などに起因する金利上昇に苦しむ中、日米の通貨当局は緊密な連携をとってきた。高市政権発足以降、片山、ベセント両氏はオンラインを含めて１０回ほど対話を重ねた。三村淳財務官は協調介入を「日米通貨同盟の完成形」と表現。財務省関係者は「これまで大きな金融危機や災害など有事にのみ行ってきた協調介入が、平時でも行われる時代に入るということだ」と解説した。

日米両政府が米連邦準備制度の「外国・国際通貨当局（ＦＩＭＡ）向けレポ・ファシリティ」の活用に触れたのも、こうした文脈の延長線上にある。

前出の政府関係者は、こうした経緯を念頭に「協調介入の実行を高市氏は非常に評価している」と明かし、「片山氏自身も続投を望んでいる」と語った。

内閣改造の見通しと、財務相などの人事について木原稔官房長官は２４日の記者会見で「内閣改造や閣僚人事は首相が決めることだ。この場で申し上げる立場にない」と述べるにとどめた。

＜専門家が続投を求める理由＞

片山氏の「実績」を専門家はどう見ているのか。

ＳＢＩ証券チーフ債券ストラテジストの道家映二氏は、日米協調介入後に為替レートが大きく円安に戻していることなどを念頭に「片山氏の仕事に特筆すべきものがあるとは言えない」とする。一方、米側が日銀の利上げに賛成の立場を取ったり、消費減税に慎重な姿勢を示したりしていると報じられる点に言及。「米と高市政権の政策がことごとく反対の流れにある中で、両者の間で上手に立ち回っているのは事実だ」と述べた。

片山氏が自民党の金融調査会長を務めた経験にも触れ、「特に金融市場との対話に積極的な姿勢は評価できる。マーケットとしては続投が望ましい」と語った。

野村総合研究所エグゼクティブ・エコノミストの木内登英氏は、仮に片山氏が交代となった場合、「円安・債券安に対する危機感がそれほど高くない人が後任となれば、歯止めが利かなくなるリスクがある」と指摘する。

片山氏が就任前、ロイターのインタビューで円安に懸念を示したことなどから「高市氏と考え方が１００％一緒ということではないと思う」としつつ、「トランプ大統領に要所要所で進言して暴走を食い止めているベセント氏と立場が似ている」と分析。「高市政権で片山氏よりも財政再建派の人物が財務相に就く可能性は低いと見られる。その意味では続投が望ましい」と語った。

（鬼原民幸、竹本能文　編集：橋本浩）

item.title: ロシア南部にドローン攻撃、子ども2人死亡 物流拠点で火災
item.description: [２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２４日 ロイター] - ロシア南部クラスノダールで２４日未明、無人機（ドローン）の残骸が民間の保育施設に落下し、子ども２人が死亡、子ども７人を含む９人が負傷した。クラスノダール地方のコンドラチェフ知事が明らかにした。

一方、ウクライナでは北東部ハルキウ郊外へのロシアによる攻撃で３人が死亡したと、ハルキウ州知事が２３日にテレグラムに投稿した。

コンドラチェフ氏によると、クラスノダールではドローン残骸が集合住宅に落下したほか、複数の倉庫が炎上。ロシアのオンライン小売り大手オゾンによると、この攻撃で同社の物流拠点で火災が発生した。

クラスノダールに隣接するスタブロポリ地方の化学生産地域ネビノムイスクでは、工業地帯を狙ったドローンを撃墜したと、ウラジミロフ知事が２４日にテレグラムで明らかにした。

ウクライナはロシア各地の物流拠点や倉庫への攻撃を強化している。

ロシアのプーチン大統領は２２日、ウクライナがロシアの経済施設を攻撃したことで「パンドラの箱」を開けたと非難し、ロシアはウクライナ経済の急所を狙って報復すると警告した。

item.title: Fewer than 20 ships transit key Strait of Hormuz over weekend, data shows
item.description: Fewer than 20 commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz at the weekend, shipping data showed on Monday, as Iranian and U.S. blockades restrict traffic through the chokepoint for energy shipments.
item.dc:creator: Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Fewer than 20 commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz at the weekend, shipping data showed on Monday, as Iranian and U.S. blockades restrict traffic through the chokepoint for energy shipments. Four vessels crossed the strait on Sunday, initial data from shiptracker Kpler showed by 0228 GMT, with 13 on Saturday. The figures could change as some ships had switched off transponders on their way through. That compared with Friday's figure of 16 transits, with two empty very large crude carriers (VLCCs) entering the Gulf with the tracking devices switched off, one heading to Iraq and the other to Bahrain, the data showed. A VLCC carrying 2 million barrels of Emirati crude exited the strait on Thursday. Eight very large gas carriers transited the strait over the past three days, the data showed, six of them entering empty while the others carried liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) loaded from Iran and exited the Gulf. Overall traffic volumes remained suppressed in the week to August 21, as vessels aborted transit plans or switched routes through the strait's north after attacks, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said in a report. A total of 89 vessels exited the strait while 103 entered over the seven-day period, the report, based on Automatic Identification System (AIS) data, showed. "Traffic remains well below normal levels, with AIS-detected transits approximately 90% below pre-conflict baselines and declining since the June 24 to June 26 peak," it added. Tanker traffic, at 45% of the total, continued to dominate movement through the strait, the agency said. Of these, 56% were tankers that carry crude oil, oil products or chemicals while LPG carriers accounted for a further 24%. Since July 6, the UKMTO has reported 23 incidents of projectile strikes, leading to bridge, engine-room, and structural damage across vessels in the strait and its vicinity. A total of 24 commodity vessels sailed through the Bab el-Mandeb strait on Sunday, down from Saturday's figure of 32, which was an increase from 22 on Friday, Kpler data showed. Two VLCCs entered the Red Sea on Saturday with one carrying Iraqi Basrah crude and the other empty, it showed.

item.title: 豪、哺乳類で初のＨ５Ｎ１鳥インフル感染確認 南部のオットセイ
item.description: [シドニー ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シドニー ２３日 ロイター] - オーストラリアは２３日、国内で初めて哺乳類のＨ５Ｎ１型鳥インフルエンザ感染例を確認したと発表した。南オーストラリア州のオットセイからウイルスが検出された。

同国は６月に初の感染が確認されて以降、拡大への対応に追われている。今月には同ウイルスによる国内初の海鳥の大量死が発生し、状況が深刻化している。ウイルスは当初、渡り鳥から検出され、その後在来種にも広がっていた。

南オーストラリア州当局によると、哺乳類で国内初の感染例は州都アデレードの南約３１０キロにある沿岸の町ビーチポートで見つかったオットセイだった。

このオットセイは同州の海域に生息する推定１０万頭のうちの１頭で、外傷なく死んでいるのが発見されたという。

連邦政府のコリンズ農相はテレビ放映された発言で、このオットセイの死について、「他の病気や死んだ海洋哺乳類との関連性は見られない」と説明。「Ｈ５型鳥インフルエンザが自然環境で広がれば、甚大な被害を避けることは不可能だ」と語った。

政府は２２日、国内で計２９７件の感染が確認されたと発表した。家禽（かきん）や農業分野では報告されていない。

item.title: Braves edge Brewers in Little League Classic
item.description: Tyler Mahle threw five solid innings to continue his impressive run and Michael Harris II homered to help the Atlanta Braves post a 4-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Sunday in the MLB Little League Classic in Williamsport, Pa.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tyler Mahle threw five solid innings to continue his impressive run and Michael Harris II homered to help the Atlanta Braves post a 4-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Sunday in the MLB Little League Classic in Williamsport, Pa. Mahle (5-10) allowed one run on six hits while striking out four and walking two. Mahle has a 1.52 ERA in four starts since being traded from the San Francisco Giants. Raisel Iglesias earned a four-out save for Atlanta, which had dropped five of its last six games. Milwaukee starter Shane Drohan (6-5) threw five innings and allowed two runs and eight hits. He struck out five and walked three for the Brewers, who had won six of their last seven. Iglesias allowed a leadoff single to Jackson Chourio and walked Brice Turang to begin the bottom of the ninth. After William Contreras flew out to the warning track, Iglesias began a 1-6-3 double play against Jake Bauers to secure his 27th save in 30 tries. In the top of the second, Ozzie Albies and Lane Thomas singled before Mauricio Dubon slashed a ground-rule double to give the Braves a 1-0 edge. Milwaukee tied the game in the third, as Turang singled and scored on Bauers' RBI base hit. Atlanta's Drake Baldwin doubled to begin the fourth and Thomas followed that with his second single to place runners at the corners. Drohan retired the next two batters, but Sean Murphy legged out an infield single to give the Braves a 2-1 lead. Grant Anderson spelled Drohan in the sixth and allowed Dubon's one-out walk and Austin Riley's single. After he struck out Murphy, DL Hall entered as the Brewers' second reliever of the inning. Atlanta doubled its lead as Harris' soft grounder to first was bobbled by Andrew Vaughn and allowed Dubon to score. Mahle began the bottom of the sixth, but Vaughn led off with a single and Christian Yelich reached on Matt Olson's throwing error. Didier Fuentes then entered and got Joey Ortiz to ground into a double play before Luis Lara's groundout ended the threat. Lara had replaced Garrett Mitchell, who left with a forearm contusion after being hit by a pitch in the fourth. Fuentes threw two scoreless innings in relief. Dylan Lee relieved Fuentes in the eighth and surrendered a double to Yelich and a two-out triple by Lara, cutting the Brewers' deficit to 3-2. Iglesias entered and retired Gary Sanchez to strand Lara at third. Harris connected on his 21st homer of the season to give Atlanta an insurance run in the top of the ninth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Miyu Yamashita rolls to 9-shot win in Canada, ties LPGA scoring record
item.description: Miyu Yamashita tied an LPGA Tour scoring record as she sailed to a nine-shot victory at the CPKC Women's Open on Sunday in Edmonton.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miyu Yamashita tied an LPGA Tour scoring record as she sailed to a nine-shot victory at the CPKC Women's Open on Sunday in Edmonton. Yamashita was ahead by six shots after the third round and carded a 4-under-par 66 Sunday to finish at 23-under 257 for the week at Royal Mayfair Golf Club. Yuri Yoshida of Japan was a distant second at 14 under par after a 69. Not only did the rising star from Japan collect her fourth LPGA victory in 13 months, her 257 tied the tour's 72-hole record for the lowest gross score of all time. She capped that with a triumphant birdie putt on the par-4 18th hole, closing a round of six birdies and two bogeys. "I was nervous, nervous round, so my shot, my game, I trust my swing," Yamashita, 25, said on the TV broadcast. Yamashita broke through in August 2025 when she claimed her first major, the AIG Women's Open, which doubled as her first win in an official LPGA Tour event. Before that, she racked up 13 titles on the LPGA of Japan Tour. She opened the week with rounds of 62 and 64 to create plenty of space between her and the field. Yoshida's highlight was an eagle at the par-5 12th hole amid one birdie and two bogeys. She said she was looking forward to the schedule's upcoming Asian Swing, which will see the LPGA play in China, South Korea, Malaysia and Japan across October and November. "Hopefully, I can play Asian Swing, right, so I'm happy to play Asian Swing and I'm really excited to play next week, too," she said. Sei Young Kim of South Korea shot a 67 and placed third at 13 under. The low Canadian was 17-year-old Anna Huang, whose final-round 65 boosted her into a tie for fourth at 12 under with Gina Ki (71) and China's Ruoning Yin (68). Huang, a native of Vancouver, has been a revelation on the Ladies European Tour, where she's won four times since last September, most recently the PIF London Championship earlier this month. "I think always like to make a cut at any LPGA event is really special," Huang said. "And then to play so well as I did this week at the Canadian Open is just really, really awesome I guess. And, yeah, I'm really happy that I played well in front of the best in the world and, hopefully, I can continue doing that." Another rising star from Canada, 16-year-old amateur Aphrodite Deng, followed her Saturday 63 with a 69 and tied for seventh at 11 under with Laney Frye (68) and Thailand's Ariya Jutanugarn (68). --Field Level Media

item.title: Rupee set for quiet open, supported by inflows; oil, month-end activity eyed
item.description: The Indian rupee is poised for a quiet start to the week, buoyed by robust capital inflows, while traders keep an eye on oil prices and anticipated interventions by the central bank to keep the currency on a steady footing.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee is poised for a quiet start to the week, buoyed by robust capital inflows, while traders keep an eye on oil prices and anticipated interventions by the central bank to keep the currency on a steady footing. The rupee is expected to open in the 95.65-95.70 range, per traders, having settled at 95.6950 to the dollar on Friday. Oil prices slipped on Monday as investors awaited an expected announcement from Washington about imposing [USN:L1N44K05C TEXT:"more sanctions"] on Iran that may further disrupt energy supplies from the Middle East. U.S. President Donald Trump has also threatened to impose sanctions on Iran's trading partners. Uncertainty over the conflict could keep risk appetite curtailed but pressure on the rupee is expected to be offset by the Reserve Bank of India's presence in the market, similar to the last two weeks. Over the weekend, the central bank said it has garnered nearly $73 billion under measures rolled out in June to strengthen India's balance of payments, helping lift [USN:L4N44I0QN TEXT:"FX reserves"] just shy of a record high. "We expect the RBI to use inflows to reduce its FX forward book and/or rebuild FX reserves, rather than allow a material appreciation of the currency," analysts at Goldman Sachs said in a note. The firm has revised its three-, six- and 12-month rupee forecasts weaker to 96,97,97 from 94,95,96, respectively, after the RBI brought forward the closure of the discounted hedging facility for overseas deposits by a month. Elsewhere, Asian currencies and stocks were mostly rangebound, with investors awaiting results from chip major Nvidia (NVDA.O) later this week followed by a key speech from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on Friday.

item.title: Indian food safety officer shakes up Mumbai, one viral raid at a time
item.description: Tukaram Mundhe is an Indian bureaucrat on a mission.
item.dc:creator: Arpan Chaturvedi, Vibhuti Sharma, Dhwani Pandya
item.content:encoded: Tukaram Mundhe is an Indian bureaucrat on a mission. As a state food safety commissioner, the 51-year-old has raided food businesses in the country's commercial capital Mumbai in an unprecedented crackdown on poor hygiene and unsafe food that has captivated the public nationwide. Mundhe has led the suspension of food permits of [USN:L4N44B0ID TEXT:"four Domino's and one Pizza Hut"] outlet in recent weeks, and has also targeted cricket clubs, hotels and well-known restaurants in over 3,000 raids since he took over as Maharashtra's food safety chief in May. When a Mumbai judge accused Mundhe of selective aggression towards private outlets and asked if court canteens were checked, his teams conducted inspections there within hours, shutting some of them which operated without licenses. "Those who try to not comply, they will face what is expected from the regulator," Mundhe said in an interview with Reuters, talking about his no-nonsense approach. "You are dealing with the lives of people." Mundhe has won widespread public admiration across India because he has tapped into deep public frustration. Even though foreign chains such as Domino's (DPZ.O) and McDonald's (MCD.N) are fast expanding, it is local eateries, roadside kiosks and small restaurants — long dogged by concerns over hygiene — that remain hugely popular. Each year since 2020, Indian food inspectors have checked more than 100,000 food samples and found roughly 20% to be unsafe, substandard or lacking proper labels, government data shows. Nearly 8,000 food business licenses have been cancelled in the last three years. "Everyone has tried to normalise this for years by saying it happens in India. It's basically bottled-up anger," said Ankur Bisen, a partner at consumer consulting firm The Knowledge Company. "I have never seen anyone like Mundhe. It's giving people hope." FINDING RATS AND EXPIRED FOOD Mundhe, who is bespectacled and sports a chevron moustache, has an unconventional operating style. He has featured in TV interviews declaring nobody dare bribe him, and that he is not afraid of administrative action despite being transferred numerous times in his 21-year career as an officer of the highly regarded Indian Administrative Service. "I get transferred every year," he said in a 2018 interview. Now, his food safety team's actions go viral daily — raids lead to detailed public statements and graphic images that show interiors of eateries and [USN:L4N44C017 TEXT:"grocery warehouses"] with stained walls, crawling cockroaches and rats, and even expired food — photos that have shocked many Indians. "It was surprising. I did not expect these many violations," Mundhe said. In Mumbai, Reuters visits last week to 25 street vendors and restaurants showed heightened fear about Mundhe's raids. One vendor has swapped artificial red dye for natural chilli in Chinese offerings, while another has started changing his frying oil three times a day and requires staff to wear gloves and head caps. Mumbai's omnipresent street food 'vada pav' — a spicy potato patty in a bun — has not escaped Mundhe's attention. In June, he prohibited use of newspapers as packaging material — often used to wrap the delicacy. Customers are noticing the change and consuming street food more confidently. Supriya Wagle, 14, is happy her favourite vada pav is now being packed in cleaner butter paper, saying that is "surely a relief". CRITICISM AMID CELEBRITY STATUS After finding lapses at some Domino's and Pizza Hut stores, Mundhe's team on Friday suspended the permit of a McDonald's outlet after finding "live pest activity (cockroaches)" and "rotting food". The three companies did not respond to Reuters queries. Mundhe's crackdown has included action against a Mumbai British-era cricket club, a 70-year-old ice cream parlour and a 110-year-old Parsi Dairy. He is facing criticism from businesses that say they should be given time to adapt, with some approaching the High Court and accusing his department of high-handedness. In one case, the judges fined his department 500,000 rupees ($5,225) for continued suspension of an eatery even though it improved its compliance. "If there are observations by the court, we take it seriously ... if there is scope for improvement, we improve," Mundhe said. At an event in New Delhi on Friday, fans clicked quick selfies with Mundhe and jostled to shake his hand. One fan told him Prime Minister Narendra Modi should give him a national role. "I don't think I'm a celebrity. I'm just a food safety commissioner," he told Reuters.

item.title: ゴルフ＝山下が完全優勝で米ツアー4勝目、吉田2位 ＣＰＫＣ女子ＯＰ
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＣＰＫＣ女子オープンは２３日、カナダ・エドモントンのロイヤル・メイフェアＧＣ（パー７０）で最終ラウンドを行い、山下美夢有が初日からの首位を守り、完全優勝で米ツアー４勝目を挙げた。

後続に６打差をつけてスタートした山下は、６バーディー、２ボギーの６６をマーク。２位と９打差となる通算２３アンダーの２５７で今季２勝目を記録した。

２位から逆転を狙った吉田優利は１イーグル、１バーディー、２ボギーの６９で回り、通算１４アンダーで２位フィニッシュ。１打差の３位にはキム・セヨン（韓国）が入った。

西郷真央は７０で回り、通算７アンダーの１３位。６７をマークした西村優菜、７０の古江彩佳はともに通算６アンダーの１７位で大会を終えた。

畑岡奈紗は通算５アンダーで２３位。岩井千怜は通算１アンダーの４８位だった。

item.title: ブラジル大統領選、ルラ氏のリード縮小＝ダタフォーリャ世論調査
item.description: [サンパウロ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンパウロ ２１日 ロイター] - ２１日に発表されたダタフォーリャの世論調査によると、１０月に行われるブラジル大統領選で、左派の現職ルラ大統領がボルソナロ前大統領の長男である右派フラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員に対するリードを保っているが、その差は縮まっている。

決選投票を想定した場合の支持率はルラ氏が４７％、ボルソナロ氏が４３％。７月の時点では、それぞれ４８％と４３％だった。

第１回投票でいずれの候補も有効票の５０％超を獲得しなかった場合、上位２候補が決選投票に進む。２００２年以降は全てで決選投票が行われている。

item.title: North Korea preparing further Russia troop deployments, no sign move imminent, Seoul says
item.description: South Korea's Defence Ministry said North Korea was continuing preparations for an additional troop deployment to Russia, but had detected no signs that such a deployment was imminent, according to a South Korean lawmaker's office.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea's Defence Ministry said North Korea was continuing preparations for an additional troop deployment to Russia, but had detected no signs that such a deployment was imminent, according to a South Korean lawmaker's office. The assessment came after North Korea's [USN:L1N44G0IC TEXT:"Kim Yo Jong"], sister of leader Kim Jong Un, last week denied Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's claim that Pyongyang planned to send up to 50,000 more troops to Russia to fight for its ally. South Korea's Defence Ministry said in a statement to lawmaker Yu Yong-weon that North Korea had continued to supply Russia with weapons systems, including short-range ballistic missiles, according to Yu's office. North Korea is estimated to have supplied Russia with more than 15 million rounds of artillery ammunition, measured in 152-millimetre shell equivalents, it said. The lawmaker's office, citing a South Korean Defense Intelligence Agency assessment, said North Korean missiles used in the war may have improved in accuracy through battlefield data, alongside Russian technical advice and component support. The ministry also said the development of some North Korean ballistic missiles and multiple rocket launchers assessed as being intended for use in a conflict with South Korea was nearing completion, the lawmaker's office said. The ministry added that North Korea's Hwasong-12 intermediate-range ballistic missile, capable of reaching the U.S. territory of Guam, was being prepared for operational deployment, according to Yu's office. North Korea's intercontinental ballistic missiles have the flight capability to reach the U.S. mainland, the ministry said, but key technologies, including warhead re-entry, have not been verified because all test launches have been conducted on lofted trajectories. North Korea and Russia have deepened military cooperation since Moscow's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, with Pyongyang supplying artillery ammunition and missiles since 2023 and deploying troops from 2024, according to South Korean, Ukrainian and Western assessments. Moscow and Pyongyang have previously denied arms transfers.

item.title: セルビア自然保護区で大規模山火事、ＥＵがヘリ・消防隊など派遣
item.description: [ベオグラード ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベオグラード ２２日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、域内外での大規模災害や人道危機に対する緊急支援を実施する市民保護メカニズムに基づき、セルビア北東部のデリブラツカ・ペシャラ自然保護区で発生している大規模な山火事の消火活動を支援するためヘリコプターと消防隊を派遣した。ベオグラード駐在のＥＵ代表部トップが２２日、明らかにした。

首都ベオグラードから約８０キロに位置する同保護区は、砂丘と森林が混在する独特の地形で知られる。当局は同保護区のほか南西部でも発生した複数の山火事に数週間にわたり苦戦しており、２１日に市民保護メカニズムの発動を要請した。

ベオグラード駐在のＥＵ代表部トップ、アンドレアス・ベッケラート氏はＸに、「われわれは人命、生活、たぐいまれなデリブラツカ砂丘の自然遺産を守るため、セルビアと共にある」と投稿した。

セルビア緊急事態局のルカ・チャウシッチ局長は欧州からの支援について、ルーマニア、スロバキア、チェコから提供された４機のブラックホーク消防ヘリコプター、ドイツからの消防隊員５５人と車両２４台、ルーマニアからの消防隊員６９人と車両１５台で構成されていると述べた。

このほか、ロシア非常事態省の消火用航空機も、１９日にセルビアの南部都市ニシュに到着した。

チャウシッチ氏は、２２日は状況がより安定しているものの、強風が予想されており、集落と人命を守ることが最優先事項だと述べた。

item.title: Indian shares open tad higher, but Iran sanction fears weigh
item.description: Indian shares opened marginally higher on Monday after two consecutive weekly losses, though sentiment remained cautious as investors awaited details of threatened U.S. sanctions on Iran later in the session.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian shares opened marginally higher on Monday after two consecutive weekly losses, though sentiment remained cautious as investors awaited details of threatened U.S. sanctions on Iran later in the session. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) rose 0.14% to 24,285.05 and the BSE Sensex (.BSESN) added 0.11% to 77,629.56, as of 9:15 a.m. IST. Thirteen of the 16 major sectors advanced at the open, although the gains were marginal. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) gained 0.2% each. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to hold a press conference at 1800 GMT on Monday, after threatening to impose "the [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"toughest sanctions"] in history" on Iran. Iran's foreign minister dismissed the threat of new U.S. sanctions as a sign of desperation on Sunday and said the expected new measures would fail to defeat Tehran.

item.title: Zelenskiy says Ukraine not behind Nord Stream blasts, cooperating with probe
item.description: Ukraine played no role in blowing up the Nord Stream gas pipelines and is cooperating with an investigation into the matter, President Volodymyr Zelenksiy said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine played no role in blowing up the Nord Stream gas pipelines and is cooperating with an investigation into the matter, President Volodymyr Zelenksiy said on Sunday. "Ukraine has never officially taken part in any operations regarding the blowing up of the Nord Stream 2 pipeline," he told reporters in Kyiv. The Nord Stream 1 and 2 natural gas pipelines between Russia and Germany were damaged in explosions in September 2022, and two Ukrainian suspects are currently in custody on suspicion of involvement.

item.title: FIFA会長解任求め不信任投票の動き インファンティノ氏の運命は？
item.description:
世界サッカーの各地域を統括する有力連盟が、国際サッカー連盟（FIFA）のインファンティノ会長を解任するため、不信任投票の動議提出を検討している。関係者が明らかにした。同会長がワールドカップ（W杯）の権益の一部を民間投資家に売却する案を打ち出し、各連盟の反発を招いたことが背景。ロイターのスポーツ担当記者、ロヒット・ネアーは、これはFIFA史上、最も重要なガバナンス（組織統治）を巡る攻防になるだろうと指摘する。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
世界サッカーの各地域を統括する有力連盟が、国際サッカー連盟（FIFA）のインファンティノ会長を解任するため、不信任投票の動議提出を検討している。関係者が明らかにした。同会長がワールドカップ（W杯）の権益の一部を民間投資家に売却する案を打ち出し、各連盟の反発を招いたことが背景。ロイターのスポーツ担当記者、ロヒット・ネアーは、これはFIFA史上、最も重要なガバナンス（組織統治）を巡る攻防になるだろうと指摘する。

◇

ロイター　スポーツ担当記者　ロヒット・ネアー

これは要するに、誰がFIFAを支配するのか、そして会長がどれほどの信任と権力を持ちうるのかの闘いだ。FIFAのジャンニ・インファンティノ会長は、W杯の少数株式を民間投資家に売却する取引を巡り、深刻な指導力の危機に直面している。この計画はすでに撤回された。

不信任投票に関する明確な規定は存在しない。ただし、FIFAに加盟する211協会のうち、少なくとも20％が臨時総会の開催を書面で要請すれば発動しうる。投票は各国が1票ずつ。だから、世界王者のスペインも、サンマリノも1票ずつで、単純過半数の賛成が必要になる。

211の加盟協会のうち、仮に180協会がその会議に出席したとすれば、解任には90票を超える賛成が必要となる。不信任投票は基本的にこうした仕組みで行われる。

欧州サッカー連盟（UEFA）加盟国はすべて、インファンティノ氏に反対の立場だ。加盟は55協会で、55対0の全会一致で、インファンティノ氏に対抗するUEFAの方針を支持した。

アジアサッカー連盟（AFC）は47協会が加盟しているが、現時点でやや分裂している。AFCはUEFAと歩調を合わせてインファンティノ氏に反対する立場を取ったが、この方針を必ずしも支持していない加盟協会もいくつかある。

北中米・カリブ海諸国で構成するCONCACAFは、インファンティノ氏に反対の立場だ。一方、アフリカサッカー連盟のCAFは、インファンティノ氏にとって最大の支持基盤とみられる。

南米サッカー連盟（CONMEBOL）は、同氏の解任は求めないと表明している。次期会長を決めるにあたっては、民主的な投票を選好するという立場だ。インファンティノ氏は来年3月に再選を目指している。

これはおそらく、FIFA史上、最も重要なガバナンスを巡る攻防と言えるだろう。仮に不信任投票で同氏の解任が決まれば、FIFA史上初の事態となり、歴史的な転換点になるからだ。

item.title: 韓国コンテナ船が出航、北極海経由の商業航路検証 西側と摩擦も
item.description: [ソウル ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国の北極海航路経由の欧州行きコンテナ船「パンスター・アクロ」が２２日、出航した。同国としては同航路での初の商業航海となり、その実現可能性を検証するとともに、釜山を世界的な海運ハブに育て上げることを目指している。

英フェリクストウ、オランダ・ロッテルダム、ポーランド・グダニスクに寄港し、帰港までの所要日数は約４０－４５日を見込む。

韓国のパンスターが運航する２７５８ＴＥＵ（２０フィートコンテナ換算）級のパンスター・アクロは、政府支援によるこの航海で、自動車部品、化学製品を含む８３７ＴＥＵの貨物などを積み込んだ。

しかし、運航にはロシアとの協力が必要なため、西側諸国との摩擦を招く恐れもある。

韓国海洋水産省とロシア外務省はコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: Shein pourrait atteindre une valorisation de $27 mds lors de son IPO à Hong Kong
item.description: La valorisation de Shein a chuté d'environ 70% par rapport au pic de près de 100 milliards de dollars atteint lors d'un tour de table effectué il y a quatre ans, alors que le géant en ligne chinois de la mode éphémère entend lever jusqu'à 1,77 milliards de dollars en vue de son introduction en Bourse à Hong Kong.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La valorisation de Shein a chuté d'environ 70% par rapport au pic de près de 100 milliards de dollars atteint lors d'un tour de table effectué il y a quatre ans, alors que le géant en ligne chinois de la mode éphémère entend lever jusqu'à 1,77 milliards de dollars en vue de son introduction en Bourse à Hong Kong. D'après des documents déposés lundi, Shein propose 280 millions d'actions à un prix unitaire compris entre 47,60 et 49,50 dollars hongkongais, ce qui valorise le groupe à près de 27 milliards de dollars américains en tenant compte du haut de la fourchette. Il s'agit d'un montant en forte baisse par rapport à des tours de table effectués en 2022, qui valorisaient alors Shein à 98,2 milliards de dollars. La société était valorisée à 64 milliards de dollars en 2023 puis en avril 2024. Comme rapporté la semaine dernière, Shein entrera en cotation le 1er septembre. L'entreprise a fait savoir qu'elle annoncerait la veille le prix final de ses actions. Plus tôt cet été, quand il a débuté des réunions avec des investisseurs en vue de son IPO, le géant de la 'fast fashion' visait une valorisation comprise entre 30 milliards et 40 milliards de dollars. Mais le groupe a fait face à des interrogations sur sa croissance, qui a connu un ralentissement, sur la hausse de ses coûts et sur l'évolution des conditions du marché. Des investisseurs ont dit par le passé ne pas être convaincus que Shein puisse retrouver les taux de croissance qui justifiaient il y a quatre ans une valorisation de près de 100 milliards de dollars. Selon le prospectus communiqué lundi par Shein, les investisseurs de référence, au premier rang desquels les actionnaires existants Boyu, Tiger Global et General Atlantic, ont souscrit à environ 383 millions de dollars d'actions. Tencent (0700.HK) , Greenwoods, Taikang Life et UBS Asset Management vont également acquérir des actions. Le géant chinois a déclaré qu'il utiliserait environ 80% des fonds levés lors de son IPO pour améliorer sa technologie et renforcer sa marque ainsi que sa présence mondiale. D'après les documents, il s'est engagé à verser jusqu'à environ 3,5 milliards de dollars en espèces à certains investisseurs ayant acquis des actions spéciales lors de précédents tours de table privés. Les actions vendues lors de l'IPO à Hong Kong attribueront un dixième des droits de vote des actions détenues par les fondateurs de la société. Les cofondateurs Sky Yangtian Xu, Maggie Gu, Molly Miao et Tony Ren contrôleront 90% des droits de vote de Shein, est-il indiqué également.

item.title: ホルムズ海峡の船舶通航、週末は20隻下回る 封鎖で輸送制限
item.description: [シンガポール ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シンガポール ２４日 ロイター] - 調査会社ケプラーの船舶追跡データによると、週末にホルムズ海峡を通過した商品輸送船は２０隻未満だった。イランと米国による封鎖措置により、エネルギー輸送の要衝である同海峡の船舶通航が制限されている。

同社の暫定データによると、０１２４ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前１０時２４分）時点で、２３日に海峡を通過した船舶は４隻、２２日は１３隻だった。通過中にトランスポンダー（識別信号発信装置）を切っていた船舶もあるため、これらの数字は変わる可能性がある。

item.title: Man suspected of murdering five in Oregon found dead
item.description: A man suspected of killing five people in rural Oregon was found dead in a suspected suicide, local law enforcement said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A man suspected of killing five people in rural Oregon was found dead in a suspected suicide, local law enforcement said on Sunday. The deceased individuals were found on Saturday at a home in a rural community near Forest Grove, Oregon, around 30 miles (48 km) outside Portland, when authorities responded to a report of a vehicle fire. An unspecified number of domesticated animals were also found deceased at the home, authorities said. "In my 22 years here, I have not been a part of or witnessed a scene quite this complex," said Caprice Massey, the sheriff in Washington County, Oregon, where the alleged killings occurred. The Washington County Sheriff's Office identified 36-year-old Benjamin Charles Parker as the suspect. Local police found Parker dead in his vehicle in Enumclaw, Washington, around 45 miles outside Seattle. He is believed to have died by suicide, they said.

item.title: テニス＝ガウフがシンシナティ2度目の優勝、男子はフィス初制覇
item.description: ［シンシナティ ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［シンシナティ　２３日　ロイター］ - テニスのシンシナティ・オープンは２３日、男女シングルス決勝を行い、女子は世界ランキング４位のコリ・ガウフが同３位ジェシカ・ペグラとの米国勢対決を６─２、６─４で制し、大会２度目の優勝を飾った。

ガウフは第１セットで２度のブレークを奪い、５─０と大きくリード。ペグラに１度ブレークを許したものの、６─２で先取した。

第２セットも序盤にブレークして３─０と先行。ペグラに５─４まで追い上げられたが、最後はブレークを奪って勝負を決めた。四大大会２勝のガウフはツアー通算１２個目のシングルスタイトルを獲得し、全米オープンに向けて弾みをつけた。

男子は第２１シードのアルトゥール・フィス（フランス）が第１７シードのフランシス・ティアフォー（米国）を６─３、１─６、６─０で下し、マスターズ１０００大会で初優勝を飾った。

item.title: 米コロラド川、下流3州への給水削減決定 カリフォルニアやアリゾナ
item.description:
Andrew Hay Nichola Groom
[２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Hay　Nichola Groom

[２１日 ロイター] - 米政府は２１日、干ばつに見舞われているコロラド川の管理を目的に、下流に位置するカリフォルニア、ネバダ、アリゾナの３州への給水を削減する２年間の計画を最終決定した。２０２９年以降さらに大幅削減する可能性も残した。

バーガム内務長官が署名した計画によると、「下流域州」と呼ばれる３州は、２０２７年と２８年にコロラド川からの取水量を約２１％削減されるが、その後は削減幅がほぼ倍増する可能性がある。

アリゾナ州とネバダ州は、２９年以降に削減幅が倍増すれば経済に壊滅的な影響が及ぶと警告。アリゾナ州は水に関する権利を守るため連邦政府を提訴する構えを示している。

一方、「上流域州」と呼ばれるコロラド、ユタ、ニューメキシコ、ワイオミングの４州は、新たな１０年計画の下で義務的な削減の対象とはならない。この計画は２年ごとに見直される。

上流域州と下流域州は、水量が縮小しているコロラド川の管理方法を巡り３年間にわたって協議を進めたが、上流域州が取水削減を受け入れず決裂。連邦政府が介入することになった。コロラド川は米国民の１０人に１人へ水を供給し、米国の食料生産量の１５％を生み出す農地を潤し、７州で６００万人分の発電をもたらしている。

コロラド川の管理を巡る１９２２年の協定では、上下流域にほぼ同量の水を割り当てられたが、歴史的には下流３州の方がより多くの水を利用。協議ではその部分が主な争点となった。

アリゾナ州のホッブズ知事（民主党）は、連邦政府が２７、２８年の取水削減について下流域州の提案を採用したことを歓迎。一方で、政府計画では下流域州が得るべき水量が供給されないとし、水の利用権を守るために法的措置を採る可能性を示した。

カリフォルニア州のニューサム知事（民主党）は、コロラド川に依存する７州全てが節水に取り組む必要があると主張。声明で「この運用計画は短期的な安定をもたらすに過ぎない」とし、「長期的な解決策は、コロラド川を取り巻く新たな現実を踏まえ、７州全てが公平に責任を分担するものでなければならない」と述べた。

item.title: Alibaba shares fall 8% after $10 billion Hong Kong share sale
item.description: Alibaba shares fell 8% in early Hong Kong trade on Monday after the tech company finalised a HK$80 billion ($10.21 billion) share placement at HK$112.70 apiece, in a deal aimed at funding artificial intelligence-related development.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alibaba (9988.HK) shares fell 8% in early Hong Kong trade on Monday after the tech company finalised a HK$80 billion ($10.21 billion) share placement at HK$112.70 apiece, in a deal aimed at funding artificial intelligence-related development. The Chinese e-commerce and cloud computing company priced 710 million new shares at an 8.4% discount to the last close of its Hong Kong-listed stock. The deal is the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company and the third-largest globally this year after offerings by [USN:L4N4291N6 TEXT:"Alphabet"] (GOOGL.O) and [USN:L6N4470KC TEXT:"Intel"] (INTC.O) . Alibaba intends to use proceeds to fund AI development, including the expansion of related infrastructure. The share placement comes a week after Alibaba reported quarterly earnings in which it said it had already spent nearly half of its three-year capital expenditure plan. It brought forward its projected payback on AI investment to two and a half years from three due to surging demand for AI services. Its [USN:L4N44H0OB TEXT:"quarterly net profit"] fell 75% from a year earlier due primarily to AI-related spending. Last week, digital technology and AI division Alibaba Cloud launched its third data centre in South Korea , bringing its network to 104 availability zones across 30 regions. The move was a part of Alibaba's AI infrastructure pledge, announced in October, [USN:L5N3VU0SZ TEXT:"to invest 380 billion yuan"] ($56.54 billion) over three years. ($1 = 7.8391 Hong Kong dollars) ($1 = 6.7210 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Dollar trading near multi-month lows, restrained by debt nerves
item.description: A wavering dollar teetered near multi-month lows on Monday in a market unsettled by the U.S. Treasury's promise to buy back more long bonds, while traders awaited details of sanctions on Iran and on policy speeches this week in the U.S. and Japan.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: A wavering dollar teetered near multi-month lows on Monday in a market unsettled by the U.S. Treasury's promise to buy back more long bonds, while traders awaited details of sanctions on Iran and on policy speeches this week in the U.S. and Japan. The Canadian dollar slipped 0.2% in early trade, to C$1.3798 per dollar, after trade talks with the U.S. collapsed and Washington imposed [USN:L6N44J03R TEXT:"50% tariffs on Canadian goods"], with Canada retaliating in kind. The Australian and New Zealand dollars traded just shy of three-month highs at $0.7171 and $0.5979 respectively. The euro was comfortably above $1.16 at $1.1685 while the yen kept to the strong side of 159 per dollar. Friday data showing the strongest [USN:ZON00GDKK TEXT:"U.S. services growth"] in nearly two years in August held off dollar sellers in steady early trade. The dollar logged its largest weekly drop against bitcoin in nearly three-and-a-half years on Sunday and it's been sliding sharply on gold over [USN:L1N44H0RB TEXT:"revived fears the currency will suffer"] if the U.S. tries to hold down yields. Long-end yields have been [USN:L1N44F086 TEXT:"climbing globally"] on a combination of a solid economic growth outlook, rising inflation expectations and nerves about [USN:L6N44G17Z TEXT:"ballooning sovereign debts"]. Last week, after 30-year yields hit almost two-decade highs, the U.S. Treasury announced it would [USN:L1N44G0GD TEXT:"double buybacks"] at the long end to $4 billion per operation. The size is paltry in a market worth $32 trillion but the interventionist signal spooked traders and hit the dollar. "The U.S. Treasury's attempts to artificially hold down long-term bond yields appears to be reigniting the $US debasement trade," said Shane Oliver, head of investment strategy at Australian financial services firm AMP. The mood was keeping Australian dollar above 71 cents, he said. Sterling was firm at $1.3650 in morning trade and the yuan , which notched an eighth straight weekly rise last week, hovered near a 3/1-2 year high at 6.7222 per dollar. SANCTIONS AND WARSH Later on Monday, at 1800 GMT, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to hold a press conference after threatening "[USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"the toughest sanctions in history"]" on Iran, with markets focused on whether he will target [USN:L6N44H0PZ TEXT:"China"]. Iran's foreign minister has dismissed the threat of new U.S. sanctions as a sign of desperation. Market participants will also be hoping for some clarity on the outlook for U.S. interest rates when Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speaks in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, on Friday. He is also sure to face questions about Treasury's buybacks. "Any comments on the balance sheet, duration supply, or term premium could move the long end more than the data itself. That said, given Warsh’s typically restrained style, we aren’t holding our breath," said BNY strategist Geoff Yu. A Thursday appearance by Bank of Japan deputy governor Ryozo Himino will also be closely watched as a prelude to next month's policy meeting. In particular, investors will be looking to see if he pushes back on a shift in market pricing to see a faster pace of hikes. "Himino may signal the BOJ is moving closer to another interest rate hike," said Commonwealth Bank of Australia strategist Joe Capurso. "However, any hawkish comments are likely to exert only modest downward pressure on USD/JPY. Developments in the U.S. bond market area are a more important driver of USD/JPY."

item.title: 台湾南部で豪雨、地方政府が休業・休校指示 週末に台風接近へ
item.description: [台北 ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[台北 ２４日 ロイター] - 台湾南部の広い地域で２４日、豪雨のため地方政府が官公庁や学校を休業・休校とした。今週末には台風が台湾北部に影響を及ぼす見通しとなっている。

台湾南部ではここ数日、低気圧が停滞し、豪雨が発生し、洪水を引き起こしている。

人口４００万人超を抱える高雄市と台南市の両市政府が官公庁と学校の休業・休校を指示。屏東県、嘉義県のほか、山岳部の東部に位置する台東県と花蓮県も同様の措置を取った。

高雄市当局は、低気圧による５日間の累積降水量が１．３メートルを超えると予想。これは同市が通常１年間に見込む雨量のほぼ半分に相当する。

台湾中央気象署は、現在日本の沖縄地方に向かっている台風１８号（ソウデル）が、２８日に台湾北部付近を通過した後、中国東部沿岸に到達する見込みだと発表した。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: 中国で開発された人型ロボットが22日、北京で開催中の「世界ヒューマノイドロボット競技大会」の100メートル走予選で9秒39を記録し、ウサイン・ボルト氏（ジャマイカ）が持つ男子世界記録の9秒58を上回った。 この記録を出したのは北京人形機器人創新中心が開発した「天工ウルトラ」で、序盤は出遅れたものの、スマートフォンメーカーのオナーが手がけた「ライトニング」をゴール直前で抜き去り優勝した。ライトニングも9秒47でゴールし、ボルト選手の記録を上回った。 両機ともゴールを駆け抜けると、そのまま制動用マットに激突。ライトニングは地面に倒れ込み、担架で運び出された。 昨年の第1回大会で天工ウルトラの記録は21秒50で、今年は大幅に技術が進歩した。 中国政府にとって人型ロボットは戦略的な新興産業。19日には有力メーカーの宇樹科技（ユニツリー）が上海証券取引所に上場し、株価が公開価格の5倍超に急騰、時価総額は約500億ドルに達した。 今年の大会は16カ国から666チーム、2056機が参加し、初開催時の280チームから大幅に増加した。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝鈴木2安打3得点、大谷は無安打 千賀ら3投手に黒星
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２３日、各地で試合を行い、カブスの鈴木誠也外野手はマリナーズ戦に「２番・右翼」で先発し、３打数２安打、３四球、３得点、１盗塁だった。

カブス先発の今永昇太投手は初回に先頭打者本塁打を浴び、三回は２打者を出塁させて一つもアウトを取れずに降板。２回０／３を投げ、５安打、３四死球、４三振、２失点（自責１）で勝敗は付かなかった。カブスは１９─２で大勝した。

ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はパイレーツ戦に「１番・指名打者」で先発し、３打数無安打、１四球、１得点、１盗塁、１三振。初回に四球で出塁して今季９個目の盗塁を決め、その後に先制のホームを踏んだ。ドジャースは４─０で勝ち、６連勝を飾った。

メッツの千賀滉大投手はホワイトソックス戦の九回に４番手で登板し、１／３回を１安打１失点。サヨナラ本塁打を浴び、今季９敗目（０勝）を喫した。ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手は「２番・一塁」で先発し、３打数無安打、１四球、２三振だった。試合はホワイトソックスが２─１で制した。

左肩の炎症から復帰したエンゼルスの菊池雄星投手はレンジャーズ戦に先発し、５回を７安打、２四死球、４三振、２本塁打、５失点。今季４敗目（０勝）を喫した。エンゼルスは３─５で敗れた。

ロッキーズの菅野智之投手はガーディアンズ戦に先発し、３回を９安打、１四球、２三振、５失点で今季７敗目（１２勝）。ロッキーズは２─７で敗れた。

ヤンキース戦に「５番・三塁」で先発したブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手は、３打数１安打、１四球だった。チームは３─８で敗戦。

パドレスの松井裕樹投手はツインズ戦の九回に３番手で登板し、１回を１安打無失点、１三振。パドレスは８─１で勝利した。

item.title: サッカー＝橋岡が移籍後初得点、佐野はフル出場 ドイツ杯1回戦
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ・カップ（杯）は２３日、各地で１回戦を行い、ボルシアＭＧは敵地で下部リーグのショット・マインツと対戦し、５─０で快勝。フル出場した橋岡大樹が今夏の移籍後初ゴールを挙げた。

先発した橋岡は１点リードで迎えた前半２６分、ペナルティーエリア右で味方のクロスをヘッド。これがそのままゴールに吸い込まれた。チームメートの板倉滉は後半１２分から、町野修斗は同２５分から途中出場した。

マインツの佐野海舟は、９─０と大勝したクリーショウ戦でフル出場。チームメートの川崎颯太はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

ザンクトパウリの藤田譲瑠チマ、原大智、安藤智哉は、０─２で敗れたロートバイス・エッセン戦でいずれも先発した。安藤はフル出場、藤田が後半１５分まで、原が同２０分までそれぞれプレーした。

フライブルクの鈴木唯人は、５─１で快勝したデュッセルドルフ戦で先発し、後半２４分までプレー。チームメートの長田澪はフル出場し、後藤啓介は同４１分から途中出場した。

ボーフムの三好康児は、２─１で勝利したグロイター・フュルト戦でフル出場し、グロイター・フュルトのアペルカンプ真大もフル出場。ダルムシュタットの古川陽介は、２─１で勝利したカールツァイス・イェーナ戦で後半３３分から出場した。

item.title: 米、「経済版Ｄデー」開始へ イランは石油輸出の全面停止警告
item.description:
Yasmine Ghania Kanishka Singh
[カイロ／ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yasmine Ghania　Kanishka Singh

[カイロ／ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２３日、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）に寄稿し、イランに対し「史上最大の金融攻撃」を警告した。一方、イランは経済戦争が続けば湾岸からの石油輸出を全面停止するとけん制した。

米政府はイランの貿易相手国を標的とする経済制裁の発動を準備しており、ベセント氏は米東部時間２４日午後１時（日本時間２５日午前２時）に記者会見を開く。

同氏は寄稿で「夜明けとともに経済版Ｄデーが始まる。敵対国に対して実施された史上最大の金融攻撃だ」と述べた。

具体的な措置には触れなかったものの、イランの経済・金融システムと関わることで「宥和」を図る「おびえた国々」を標的にすると示唆し、「それ（宥和）を続けることの結果を熟考した方がよい」とした。

一方、イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は２３日、経済的な報復を示唆した。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で「経済戦争が続くなら、ホルムズ海峡経由であれ、ペルシャ湾のどこからであれ、一滴の石油も輸出されなくなる」と表明。「イランはいかなる国であれ、イラン国民に対する米国の経済戦争への参加や支援を戦争行為と見なす」とした。

こうした中、イランはパキスタンのムニール陸軍元帥が地域の平和と安全を回復する取り組みの一環として、２４日にテヘランを訪問すると発表した。詳細は不明。

パキスタン政府筋によると、ムニール氏は米国による新たな制裁の威嚇を含む最近の情勢に触れる見通し。

item.title: Inflow cushion to anchor rupee against month-end flows; bonds track oil, Treasuries
item.description: The Indian rupee is likely to be rangebound this week as robust capital inflows, supported by policy measures, help contain volatility, while government bonds may face headwinds as markets focus on oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia, Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee is likely to be rangebound this week as robust capital inflows, supported by policy measures, help contain volatility, while government bonds may face headwinds as markets focus on oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields. The rupee closed nearly flat at 95.6950 on Friday, down about 0.3% week-on-week but avoiding steeper losses on account of sustained interventions by the Reserve Bank of India. Over the weekend, the central bank said it has garnered [USN:L4N44J00P TEXT:"nearly $73 billion"] under measures rolled out in June to strengthen India's balance of payments, helping boost the country's [USN:L4N44I0QN TEXT:"FX reserves"] in striking distance of their record high. Bankers and analysts say inflows have bolstered the central bank's ammunition to anchor the currency, which is expected to persist this week. "Market participants want to position long Dollars but are fearing RBI presence around 95.80. Interbank activity and participation therefore seemed muted," FX advisory firm IFA Global said in a note. Month-end flows related to derivative maturities and corporate payments are among the factors, which could strain the rupee this week alongside still elevated oil prices due to Iran war. After nearly [USN:L6N44J01G TEXT:"six months of war"] since the U.S. and Israel launched airstrikes against Iran on February 28, the sides are not firing at each other but also showing no sign of pursuing peace talks. Outcomes of central bank policy reviews in South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand will also be in focus as policymakers navigate inflationary pressures and volatility spurred by the Middle East conflict. BONDS Government bonds are likely to trade in a narrow range, after the benchmark bond yield witnessed its sharpest weekly rise so far this financial year in the previous week, crossing the crucial level of 6.85%. The 10-year bond yield ended at 6.8495% on Friday, up 9 basis points, the biggest spike since the week ended April 3, after falling an aggregate of 7 basis points in the previous two weeks. Traders expect the benchmark yield to move in the 6.80% to 6.89% range, with a trading holiday on Wednesday and commentary from Fed officials on Thursday-Friday. The minutes of RBI's latest meeting released on Wednesday showed policymakers are open to rate hikes, if inflation risks materialise and broaden. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said that evidence of such spillovers could warrant "policy tightening", while Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said a case for a hike may emerge this year. The benchmark Brent crude contract gained nearly 7% last week and was around $94 per barrel mark, a concern for India's inflation outlook. The focus would also remain on foreign investors after India was not included in a global index on July 31. "The delay does not change India's structural story, and other factors, such as the strong inflows into the non-resident scheme, could provide near-term support," said Shamaila Khan, head of fixed income for emerging markets and Asia-Pacific at UBS Asset Management. KEY FACTORS: ** India July industrial output – August 28, Friday (4:00 p.m. IST) U.S. ** August consumer confidence - August 25, Tuesday (7:30 p.m. IST) ** July new home sales units - August 25, Tuesday (7:30 p.m. IST) ** July personal consumption expenditure, core PCE - August 26, Wednesday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** July durable goods - August 26, Wednesday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** April-June GDP second estimate - August 26, Wednesday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** Initial weekly jobless claims for the week to August 22 - August 27, Thursday (6:00 p.m. IST) ** August U Mich sentiment final - August 27, Thursday (7:30 p.m. IST)

item.title: Alibaba stock slumps in Hong Kong after $10.2 billion share placement to fund AI
item.description: The Hong Kong-listed shares of Alibaba slumped on Monday after the Chinese e-commerce and cloud computing company launched a $10.2 billion share placement, as investors worried about payback from its massive AI spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Hong Kong-listed shares of Alibaba (9988.HK) slumped on Monday after the Chinese e-commerce and cloud computing company launched a $10.2 billion share placement, as investors worried about payback from its massive AI spending. Alibaba said on Sunday its HK$80 billion ($10.21 billion) share [USN:L6N44K00V TEXT:"placement"] finalised at HK$112.70 apiece – an 8.4% discount to its Friday close – is aimed at funding AI-related development, as it redoubles AI bets amid competition and simmering Sino-U.S. tech rivalry. Its shares fell as much as 10% to HK$110.10 in early Hong Kong trade. "It's negative news in the short-term ... as the share placement dilutes shareholders' interest," said Charles Wang, chairman of Shenzhen Dragon Pacific Capital Management. "In addition, investors generally don't like capex ... though the investment is beneficial in the long term." The view echoes concern in the U.S. where investors increasingly question when massive AI spending will generate returns. The deal is the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company and the third-largest globally this year after offerings by [USN:L4N4291N6 TEXT:"Alphabet"] (GOOGL.O) and [USN:L6N4470KC TEXT:"Intel"] (INTC.O) . Alibaba intends to use proceeds to fund AI development, including the expansion of related infrastructure. The share placement comes a week after Alibaba reported quarterly earnings in which it said it had already spent nearly half of its three-year capital expenditure plan. It brought forward its projected payback on AI investment to two and a half years from three due to surging demand for AI services. Its [USN:L4N44H0OB TEXT:"quarterly net profit"] fell 75% from a year earlier due primarily to AI-related spending. Last week, digital technology and AI division Alibaba Cloud launched its third data centre in South Korea , bringing its network to 104 availability zones across 30 regions. The move was a part of Alibaba's AI infrastructure pledge, announced in October, [USN:L5N3VU0SZ TEXT:"to invest 380 billion yuan"] ($56.54 billion) over three years.

item.title: サッカー＝バルセロナ、エルチェに5発圧勝 3連覇へ好スタート
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２３日、各地で試合を行い、昨季王者のバルセロナが敵地でエルチェに５─０で大勝した。

リーグ初戦を迎えたバルセロナは、前半１４分にラフィーニャが自ら獲得したＰＫで先制点を挙げると、同アディショナルタイム３分には新戦力のカリム・アデイェミが移籍後公式戦初ゴールを記録した。

ハーフタイム前に右膝の痛みを訴えたガビが交代を強いられたバルセロナだが、後半２２分にはラフィーニャがこの日２ゴール目をマーク。その後もフェルミン・ロペスが２得点を加え、３連覇に向けて好スタートを切った。

アトレティコ・マドリードは、ビジャレアルをホームに迎え、２─２のドロー。ヘタフェはホームでのラシン戦を１─０で制した。

item.title: Browns waive Dae'Quan Wright, paving reported return to college at LSU
item.description: The Cleveland Browns waived tight end Dae'Quan Wright on Sunday, paving a path for him to return to college football at LSU so long as he clears NFL waivers, his representation told ESPN.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Cleveland Browns waived tight end Dae'Quan Wright on Sunday, paving a path for him to return to college football at LSU so long as he clears NFL waivers, his representation told ESPN. Wright -- who signed with the Philadelphia Eagles as an undrafted free agent and then landed with Cleveland via waivers but hasn't appeared in either of their first two preseason games -- is believed to be the first player with an agreement in place to return to college football after signing an NFL contract as an undrafted free agent. Wright played the last two seasons for new LSU coach Lane Kiffin at Ole Miss, catching 39 passes for 635 yards and five touchdowns for the Rebels in 2025. He amassed 113 catches, 1,603 receiving yards and nine touchdown catches over four seasons at Virginia Tech (2022-23) and Ole Miss (2024-25). He's one of 16 football players who was granted a temporary restraining order earlier this week by a Louisiana judge to be deemed eligible for the 2026 college season. The NCAA initially ruled that all players whose eligibility expired after the 2025 season will not be eligible for its new five-year eligibility model. Wright officially entered the transfer portal Thursday and could join the 11th-ranked Tigers -- who open the season at home Sept. 5 vs. Clemson -- in the near future. The NCAA continues to fight against these players becoming eligible, receiving a stay from the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals on Friday. However, that stay doesn't erase the players who have already had their eligibility restored by TROs given by state-court judges across the country over the last few weeks. The other players who have reportedly entered the transfer portal this week after the Louisiana court ruling include one of Wright's Ole Miss teammates, defensive lineman Zxavian Harris, former SMU running back TJ Harden, former BYU offensive lineman Weylin Lapuaho, former James Madison linebacker Trent Hendrick, former Appalachian State defensive back Ethan Johnson and former New Mexico kicker Luke Drzewiecki. ESPN also reported this week that two other players in NFL camps, Jack Pyburn of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Wydett Williams Jr. of the Arizona Cardinals, can go back to school under the TRO. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝リバプール、終盤のＰＫでドロー ブライトンは4発完勝
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２３日、開幕節を行い、遠藤航が所属するリバプールは敵地でニューカッスルに２─２で引き分けた。

前半５分に先制されたリバプールは、後半１０分にコディ・ハクポが同点弾を記録。同１２分に再びリードを許したが、ビクトル・ムニョスが獲得したＰＫを同アディショナルタイム９分にドミニク・ソボスライが決めて、勝ち点１を獲得した。遠藤はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

三笘薫が所属するブライトンは、今夏に鈴木彩艶が加入したアストンビラをホームに迎え、４─０で完勝した。三笘はメンバー外。鈴木はベンチ入りしたものの、出場機会はなかった。

今季からエンツォ・マレスカ監督が就任したマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）は、ホームでボーンマスと対戦。前半２６分に先制された後、後半３９分と同アディショナルタイム１分に得点し、２─１で逆転勝利した。

item.title: ポーランド格付け「Ａ－」、見通し「ネガティブ」を維持＝フィッチ
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２１日 ロイター] - 格付け会社フィッチ・レーティングスは２１日、ポーランドのソブリン信用格付けを「Ａ－」に据え置いた。同格の他国より経済が底堅く、対外収支が健全なことを理由に挙げた。一方、財政健全化が不十分だとして、見通しは「ネガティブ」に維持した。

同国の財政赤字は７月末時点で１４１１億ズロチ（３８１億９０００万ドル）と、６月末の１２３７億ズロチ（３３４億８０００万ドル）から拡大した。

フィッチは、２０２７年財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比は６．７％とわずかに縮小する見込みとしたが、２月時点に示した６．２％の予想を上回る水準となった。また、選挙を控えた追加歳出のリスクを指摘した。

２６年のＧＤＰ成長率は３．３％と予想。欧州連合（ＥＵ）の復興・強靭化ファシリティー（ＲＲＦ）による事業や高水準の防衛支出が、実質賃金の伸び鈍化に伴う個人消費の減速を一部相殺する形で投資を支えるとの見通しを示した。

ドマンスキ財務相は「ポーランド経済は引き続き力強く、底堅く、十分多様化しているとフィッチはみている」とＸに投稿。「しかし、格付け各社は財政へのリスクを示唆しており、フィッチは、記録的に多い大統領の拒否権発動で実効性のある経済政策の実施能力が制約されるとの見方を明確に示している」と指摘した。

item.title: The Hormuz crude volume debate masks the real shortage of refined fuels
item.description: The crude oil market is currently engaged in the wrong debate over how much oil is actually moving via the Strait of Hormuz. It should be debating the constrained flows of refined products around Asia.
item.dc:creator: Clyde Russell
item.content:encoded: The crude oil market is currently engaged in the wrong debate over how much oil is actually moving via the Strait of Hormuz. It should be debating the constrained flows of refined products around Asia. U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright has repeatedly claimed that much more crude is getting through the disputed strait than vessel-tracking analysts such as Kpler can see. One of Wright's claims was that about 15 million barrels per day (bpd) exited the Strait of Hormuz on a day last week, which if true would take volumes close to what they were before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on February 28. Wright has also said transits averaged about 9 million bpd over a seven-day period, although he didn't specify the exact dates and he has not provided details such as vessel names and their intended destinations. Vessel monitoring services estimate that around 5 million bpd is leaving the Strait of Hormuz, and that includes so-called dark transits and ship-to-ship transfers from smaller vessels to larger tankers in the Gulf of Oman. But the dispute over crude oil volumes is a false debate. If Wright is correct then Asia's oil imports will start to pick up in coming weeks as the crude he claims is leaving the Middle East arrives at ports. It's considerably easier to track import volumes, so it's merely a matter of time before the market can assess whether Wright is correct, or whether his numbers are overstated. In the meantime Asia's refined products markets remain stressed, as shown by sharply lower volumes and extremely elevated refining margins. Asia's imports of light and middle distillates for August are estimated by Kpler at 5.59 million bpd, in line with the 5.60 million bpd seen in July. However, these volumes are down 21% from the 7.08 million bpd average in the three months to the end of February. In effect, Asia is having to absorb a drop of 1.49 million bpd of key fuels such as diesel, jet fuel and gasoline. UNEVEN FALLOUT The impact is also not being evenly spread across the world's top-energy consuming continent, with less wealthy countries shouldering a bigger share of the loss of product volumes. Indonesia's imports of light and middle distillates are estimated at 432,000 bpd in August, the lowest in 13 months and down from an average of 533,000 bpd in the three months prior to the start of the Iran conflict. The Philippines is expected to see arrivals of 257,000 bpd of light and middle distillates in August, down from an average of 362,000 bpd in the three months to the end of February. A wealthier country like Australia, the world's biggest importer of diesel, is managing to secure the same levels of fuel, with August imports of light and middle distillates estimated by Kpler at 863,000 bpd, only slightly below the 880,000 bpd in the three months prior to the Iran war. But securing fuel is coming at a high cost, with product prices remaining near record high levels and refining margins staying elevated. The profit of making a barrel of gasoil, the building block for diesel, at a Singapore refinery was $71.29 a barrel on August 21, down from the record high of $85.63 on March 30 but also 226% higher than the $21.90 that prevailed on February 27, the day before the conflict started. Most of the stress in refined products has been felt in middle distillates, given the constrained supply of Middle East crudes, many of which are medium in gravity. Asia's refineries are tailored to process this type of oil into products such as diesel and jet fuel. But even gasoline, the main light distillate, is commanding a high premium, with the profit margin ending at $20.74 a barrel on August 21, up 159% from $8.00 on February 27. The message the market is giving is that while there may be sufficient crude oil reaching Asia, it's not necessarily the correct grades and those countries with spare refining capacity aren't ramping up exports to meet demand.
